title: Make distinct-launch callback identity authorized and fail closed
objective: Implement the accepted B674 root-cause repair without its allowlist bypass or fail-open launch. A worker child may start only after its exact request identity is durably bound under the exact runner/topic authority; same-request terminal retries deduplicate and a distinct launch gets one new durable wake.
acceptance: Preserve B674's useful request_id-widened outbox migration only if every existing row is preserved, historical delivered rows are not replayed, and repeated initialization is idempotent.

Create an exact authorized launch-identity write path. Extend the runner/topic action allowlist explicitly; core.run_taskctl must receive runner and topic. Omitting identities to bypass the allowlist is forbidden.

Binding must succeed durably before the model child is spawned. A binding failure or exception rejects the launch and starts no child; perform a safe claim release/recovery if claim-start already mutated state, or make claim-and-bind atomic.

The terminal callback row must carry the exact durable request identity. Reconciliation/retry for the same request enqueues at most once, while a fresh request for the same task/transition/claim context enqueues one additional wake.
Preserve origin-thread validation, terminal-review-only routing, busy parking, batching, dead-letter recovery, process liveness and coordinator authority.

Regression tests must explicitly reject both B674 flaws: fail-open binding and identity-free core.run_taskctl. Include a no-child-spawn assertion on bind failure and isolated migration/callback lifecycle tests.
commit_contract: NO_COMMIT. Worker implements and tests only the fail-closed launch identity/callback contract; Codex owns promotion and reload.
